column1: # The platform's log mask (the course's and the product's masking of a log line): a text that
# is no field's value — a log line, an error, a JSON document, a connect string — with an Authorization header's
# credential (Authorization and Proxy-Authorization, М10/7 Н1.4), every name=value whose name is a secret's, and every address in it masked. The norm — М10/7 Н1.4 `log`
# with Н1.1а (pairs, addresses); it is not secret_in.tsv's: those are a url field's values. Owner: «Спецификация»; the
# product's conformance — its own acceptance against this table (ADR-0080 доп. 16, ADR-0083). Read by a test of the product, as a process that
# knows the product's manifests masks a log line (the names a manifest adds — sig, psd — included).
# A cell is read byte for byte between TABs, nothing is unescaped: a TAB or a line break inside a value cannot be
# written, and no row needs one; `\t`, `\n` in a cell are two characters.
# Columns, tab-separated, one row a line; a line that begins with '#' and an empty line are no row:
#   masked  what a log shows of it
#   note    why the row is here

column3: a connect string: the value runs to the end — more masked, never less
an empty value stays empty: not set is no secret
an address in a JSON text ends at its quote
a port followed by what closes a sentence is a number
a driver's RTSP client logs its request
a JSON pair: the scalar is one JSON token, what follows it stays (М10/7 Н1.4 log; S18)
a JSON pair: a string runs to its closing unescaped quote
a secret pair's value is masked to its end, an address in it included (Н1.1а А6; S17)
a pair hidden by escaping carries a password: the whole value is masked (Н1.1а А7)

column1: # rows of the acceptance copy М10/07 and Bearer (stage A review: Gemini 4.3, SA1-23)

column3: a JSON pair whose name is a secret's is a pair too
the value runs to its closing quote, past an escaped one
a number is a value too
a secret pair's value is masked whole, an address in it too, not only its userinfo (A6; reconciliation M10/6-11, S17)
a name that decodes to «&pwd» is read as pairs: the name goes with the value (A7; S17)
< does not end a pair's value: the mask runs to the end of the value (A6; S4)
the Authorization header with Bearer (М10/7 Н1.4 log; stage A review SA1-23)
